Title: Azure FXT Edge Filer now available in South Korea

Body.Content:
Azure FXT Edge Filer is now available for shipping to South Korea. This expands availability of the appliance to eighteen countries: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, France, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Switzerland, Poland, Sweden, Iceland, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Singapore, India, Taiwan, and South Korea.

Azure FXT Edge Filers are appliances running software that help to optimize hybrid storage infrastructures by accelerating access to files stored in both on-premises network-attached storage and Azure Blob.

Learn more
